name: Drevka Yuzu-Shiso Spritz
description: An artisanal-positioned spritz using real yuzu extract and synth-shiso leaf, bottled in small 200ml glass flasks with wax-sealed caps. Drevka markets aggressively to the Tier 3 office crowd.
flavor_profile: Bright citrus with a herbal, slightly anise-adjacent shiso note and fine persistent bubbles — clean and sophisticated
cultural_context: Drevka has cultivated a following among Tier 3 professionals who want to signal taste without Tier 4 prices. The wax-sealed flask is frequently repurposed as a desk accessory or gifted as a minor social gesture.
story_hooks: Drevka's 'real yuzu extract' claim is being investigated by a consumer watchdog — someone inside the company leaked a formula document showing the yuzu content is well below labeled thresholds.
A corporate fixer uses the distinctive Drevka flask as a dead-drop container because it's ubiquitous enough in Tier 3 office spaces to be invisible.
Drevka's founder is trying to buy out her own company from the Cadrex parent corp before a hostile reformulation strips the real ingredients from the recipe.
